hero.headline: I'm Igor, building software with intentionality and craft.
hero.subtitle: Senior full-stack engineer with 8+ years shipping scalable products — Java, Spring Boot, React, and TypeScript, from healthcare and EdTech to global intelligence analytics.

about.label: 01. About
about.headline: Senior full-stack engineer shipping high-impact product in complex domains.
about.body: I lead end-to-end delivery across frontend and backend — currently at Cognyte, building a global intelligence analytics platform used by security and operations teams worldwide. My work spans Java, Spring Boot, React, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL, with a strong bias toward performance, clarity, and measurable outcomes.
about.body_secondary: Before that, I shaped EdTech experiences at Konviva and healthcare workflows at Animati (radiology imaging and reporting). Along the way I’ve led cross-functional squads, mentored engineers, and turned hackathon ideas into shipped product — including an AI assistant adopted as a global product line and a flexible report builder that cut report creation time in half.

cognyte.title: Senior Software Engineer

konviva.title: Frontend Developer
konviva.description: Developed customized frontend solutions for EdTech platforms from detailed prototypes. Implemented a version control system for customer themes and maintained legacy systems while collaborating with design and backend teams.

animati.title: Fullstack Software Developer

animatiIntern.description: Contributed to the evolution of a radiology platform using Java, Spring MVC, PostgreSQL, and JavaScript. Developed reports, printing models, and new features for medical imaging workflows.
